title: docs(guide): Add "Use your own backend"
body:
This PR adds the guide for using a custom backend with InstantSearch.js: [**Use your own backend**](https://deploy-preview-2943--algolia-instantsearch.netlify.com/v2/guides/custom-backend.html).

It will get replicated for all flavors. The only part that will change is the code snippet in "Using the search client with InstantSearch".

~Note that I named the file `proxy-backend.md`, which is going to be the URL to the guide. Let me know if you think of a better name.~

Before merging it'll be great to find somewhere to host the Search Client Specification as I refer to it.
